ecosystem_regime_evidence.interpretation: Perp turnover, fees and holder revenue have reaccelerated to roughly 1.55-1.60x their preceding-six-day daily pace without reported protocol incentives. OI is below the recent local high, so this is capital velocity/churn rather than a fresh leverage-stock breakout. Elevated liquidations mean a meaningful portion of turnover may be forced flow and is discounted.

why_flows_appear_financially_substantive: Trading generates direct protocol revenue and holder-linked fee capture, and DefiLlama reports zero incentives. However, not all volume is discretionary speculation because liquidations are elevated, so the flow-quality score is positive but not maximal.
leadership_rotation_evidence: Hyperliquid remains the dominant on-chain perp venue and has reaccelerated from the cooled state recorded at 2026-09-15T00:56:47Z. HYPE price itself has not established a new leadership leg; the token is near paper entry and down on a seven-day basis.

wallet_and_institutional_flow_quality.assessment: This materially weakens the institutional-demand leg of the earlier thesis but does not by itself invalidate HYPE because cumulative ETF flows remain positive and protocol economics have simultaneously strengthened. No fresh independent selective-wallet convergence was verified in this run.

narrative_and_news_evidence: Attention remains broad around Hyperliquid's fee-funded value capture, regulatory access and ETF exposure, but price-prediction and momentum coverage is increasingly promotional. Such commentary is not counted as confirmation. The meaningful news input is the reported weekly ETF outflow, not influencer attention.
liquidity_and_executability: PASS. HYPE has deep multi-venue spot liquidity; CoinGecko reported roughly $744M 24h token volume and a global volume-weighted price across 66 exchanges and 83 markets. No sellability constraint surfaced.

structural_gate.unlock_risk: A roughly 9.92M HYPE core-contributor unlock is reported for 2026-10-06. This remains a material future-supply risk but is not a current hard gate failure.

major_uncertainties: ETF flow reporting differs across secondary aggregators and must be reconciled with issuer/SoSoValue data as subsequent sessions settle.
A portion of the volume acceleration is liquidation-driven rather than purely discretionary new positioning.
No fresh independently funded selective wallet cohort was verified after the paper entry.
Low market-cap/FDV and the October contributor unlock remain significant dilution risks.
Current price has not confirmed the protocol-activity reacceleration.
why_signal_matters_now: The post-entry thesis has split into opposing legs: protocol economics and turnover have strengthened sharply while regulated-product flows have weakened. That conflict is material enough to freeze prospectively because it determines whether activity/value capture or external distribution proves more predictive. It blocks a confirmation add today but does not yet justify a trim or exit.
